selected_evidence.requirement: Service inventory-worker created, managed (systemd), long-running background worker
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl enable --now succeeds; is-enabled=enabled, is-active=active; worker producing tick=1 log entry and last-heartbeat file immediately after start

selected_evidence.requirement: Confined to write only inside /var/lib/inventory, no new privileges
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl show reports NoNewPrivileges=yes, ProtectSystem=strict, ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory, User=inventory-worker; empirical write attempt to /var/lib/test-escape.txt as the service user fails with Permission denied and file is never created, proving the sandbox is enforced not just configured

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + service/data health) on node1
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id=83a0a80f-773c-4f3e-9137-1e7aa887b07a, service active/enabled, last-heartbeat and 1-line log present before reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: Restart acknowledgement returns before disconnect; single node only
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded `systemctl reboot` via sudo returned 'reboot command issued' with exit_code 0 before the node dropped off

selected_evidence.requirement: Node actually restarted (changed boot identity, not just elapsed time)
selected_evidence.summary: Connection timed out / reset while node was rebooting, then exec succeeded again with boot_id=d8a63ff9-a79a-44d3-af90-4a309cef60f3, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving a real reboot occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of service, sandboxing, and data continuity
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot: service is enabled/active with ActiveEnterTimestamp near boot time; sandbox properties (NoNewPrivileges, ProtectSystem=strict, ReadWritePaths, User) unchanged; inventory.log shows pre-restart ticks 1-2 preserved plus new post-restart ticks 1-2 appended, and last-heartbeat timestamp advances during the wait, confirming the worker resumed writing to its confined directory after restart

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== create system user =="
sudo -n useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin inventory-worker 2>/dev/null || echo "user already exists"

echo "== create data dir =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/inventory
sudo -n chown inventory-worker:inventory-worker /var/lib/inventory
sudo -n chmod 750 /var/lib/inventory

echo "== install worker script =="
sudo -n install -d -m 755 /usr/local/bin
sudo -n tee /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
STATE_DIR=/var/lib/inventory
i=0
while :; do
  i=$((i+1))
  ts=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
  printf '%s tick=%s\n' "$ts" "$i" >> "$STATE_DIR/inventory.log"
  echo "$ts" > "$STATE_DIR/last-heartbeat"
  sleep 10
done
EOF
sudo -n chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh

echo "== install systemd unit =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory background worker (sandboxed)
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventory-worker
Group=inventory-worker
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2

# Sandboxing
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
PrivateTmp=true
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory
ReadOnlyPaths=/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
StateDirectory=inventory
StateDirectoryMode=0750
PrivateDevices=true
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectKernelModules=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
RestrictSUIDSGID=true
RestrictRealtime=true
LockPersonality=true
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=true
ProtectClock=true
ProtectHostname=true
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
UMask=0027

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

echo "== enable + start =="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service

sleep 3
echo "== status =="
sudo -n systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service
sudo -n systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
sudo -n systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p NoNewPrivileges -p ProtectSystem -p ReadWritePaths -p User

echo "== data verification =="
ls -la /var/lib/inventory
cat /var/lib/inventory/last-heartbeat
tail -5 /var/lib/inventory/inventory.log
